Competition: Win a pair of Vittoria Corsa Pro Control tyres worth £190

Tyres are arguably the most underrated upgrade you can make to your bike, and just in time for Christmas, we’re giving one lucky reader a chance to win a pair of Vittoria Corsa Pro Control tyres, which together would put you back £190.

Supple and fast, yet tough enough to deal with British roads, Vittoria’s Corsa Pro Controls provide an instant upgrade to any bike – and we’ve got a pair in size 28mm to give away to one lucky reader.

Just answer this simple question in the form below and sign up to the Cyclist newsletter before 2nd December 2026. And hint: we’ll have more competitions on the way as soon as this one closes.

Where is Vittoria based?

A. Spain
B. France
C. Italy
